\section{Introduction / 引言}
\label{sec:intro}

The baseline describes a repeatable cyclic response and contains the inline
relation $E=mc^2$. 基线文本同时包含中文和 English tokens，以验证 Unicode 与 CJK
文本不会在转换中静默丢失。

The test sequence used in this fixture is defined in
Section~\ref{sec:methods}. A second inline quantity, $\eta=0.87$, is included
to exercise mixed prose and mathematics.
